title: Recitation check: Al-Qadr and Al-'Alaq: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-'Alaq 13 to 19, At-Tin and meem sakinah
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recitation check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 28. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ (١) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ (٢) لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ (٣) تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ (٤) سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ (٥)

keywords.def: the list of what the teacher listens for

questions.q: Recite Al-'Alaq 96:1 to 8 together, then 96:9 to 19.
Recitation check: today's group recites Al-Qadr and Al-'Alaq to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link At-Tin and tick the revision log.
questions.a: Rubric marked for each pupil, with one target.

questions.q: Extend: write your own target from today's feedback.
questions.a: For example: 'I will hold the ghunnah two counts in رَبِّهِم مِّن.'

questions.q: Which surah tells us Al-Qadr is better than a thousand months?
questions.a: A) Al-Qadr. 97:3: 'The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.'

questions.q: What do we say before we recite?
Think again: When you recite to the teacher today, what will you do to stay calm and remember?
questions.a: Breathe, say isti'adhah and Bismillah, picture the page, go ayah by ayah.
